catalog.title: Choose the input reader
catalog.values: auto (default), poscar, contcar, outcar, xml, xyz, extxyz, gaussian-input, gaussian-output, ams
catalog.description: Normally QASR detects the format from the file contents. Choose a reader explicitly when you want to constrain detection.
catalog.note: XML requires an XML-enabled build. CIF files must first be converted to a supported format.

catalog.title: Select a geometry frame
catalog.description: Choose the final geometry or a particular ionic snapshot. Frame 0 is the first snapshot; a single-frame input accepts only 0 or final.

catalog.title: Read a complete snapshot from an unfinished OUTCAR
catalog.values: Off by default; no value after the flag
catalog.description: Permit an unfinished OUTCAR when it contains a complete usable snapshot. A warning records recovery; malformed coordinates are still errors.

catalog.title: Supply missing element identities
catalog.values: Comma-separated symbols in source population order
catalog.description: Provide species for an older POSCAR without an element-symbol row. Explicit identities must agree with any identities already in the input.

catalog.title: Check the input without rendering
catalog.description: Print normalized geometry, selected frame, cell vectors, periodic axes and effective settings as JSON.

catalog.title: Inspect the displayed atoms and bonds
catalog.description: Print atom instances, complete bonds, cell edges and the fitted camera. Useful for checking expansion and connectivity.

catalog.title: Check compiled capabilities
catalog.description: Report the program version and features such as OpenMP, XML, JPEG, WebP and polygon faces.

catalog.title: See the command-line synopsis
catalog.description: Print the supported command-line syntax for your executable.

catalog.title: Check the installed version
catalog.description: Print the executable name and version.

catalog.title: Choose a drawing style
catalog.description: Use lighting for depth, flat illustrated contours, ORTEP spherical arcs, or BALSAC-inspired highlights. A style flag does not load a preset palette or camera.

catalog.title: Use monochrome or two-color stippling
catalog.description: Apply a shared black/white or navy/gold dithered palette to ORTEP or BALSAC spheres.
catalog.example: qasr examples/CONTCAR.co --no-user-config --style ortep --tone dualtone --cell off -o structure.png
catalog.note: Choose ortep or balsac when using a non-color tone.

catalog.title: Aim the camera
catalog.description: Set the direction toward the camera. Top looks along the actual a × b surface normal and aligns a with image right.
catalog.note: Top requires independent a/b cell vectors. Use a numeric direction for a cell-free molecule.

catalog.title: Rotate the image in its plane
catalog.values: 0,0,1 by default; top view chooses a-based alignment unless overridden
catalog.description: Choose the world direction that projects toward the top of the image. It must not be parallel to the viewing direction.

catalog.title: Set output dimensions
catalog.description: Set the pixel dimensions of the final image. More pixels retain detail for export or printing, at the cost of more work and memory.
catalog.note: The total-pixel and memory budgets can reject otherwise valid dimensions.

catalog.title: Choose a background or transparency
catalog.description: Set canvas color and opacity. An alpha suffix of 00 makes the background fully transparent; ff is opaque.
catalog.note: Quote color strings in a shell. JPEG requires an opaque result.

catalog.title: Smooth image edges
catalog.description: Choose the sampling quality. Native is useful for previews; 2× and 4× take more samples. Adaptive selectively refines supported geometry.
catalog.note: Some styles and scene features use full 2× sampling in adaptive mode.

catalog.title: Set atom and bond ink width
catalog.description: Adjust illustrated, ORTEP and BALSAC contours. Zero removes the contours and ORTEP arcs.

catalog.title: Choose the rendering backend
catalog.description: The Z-buffer resolves intersecting surfaces and supports the full drawing interface. Cairo is an optional experimental painter with depth and feature limitations.
catalog.note: Cairo requires a special build and does not support every style, polygon faces, annotations or multiple render threads.

catalog.title: Repeat a periodic cell
catalog.description: Repeat the structure in the positive lattice-vector directions. Every bond requires both endpoint atoms in the displayed cells.
catalog.note: Only periodic axes can repeat. Reset centered expansion before using an ordinary repeat.

catalog.title: Add neighbors around the primary cell
catalog.description: Add this many neighboring cells on each side along a and b. A value of 1,1 gives a centered 3 × 3 patch. Bonds to included neighbors remain connected.
catalog.note: Bonds stop at the outer displayed boundary. Centered expansion and nontrivial ordinary repetition are mutually exclusive.

catalog.title: Distinguish periodic neighbors
catalog.values: normal, muted, greyscale; centered expansion defaults to muted
catalog.description: Keep the primary cell in its element palette and choose how neighboring atom copies are colored. Geometry and atom opacity are preserved.

catalog.title: Scale every atom radius
catalog.description: Multiply the display radii of all atoms. Smaller spheres reveal bonds and polygon faces without moving atoms or changing connectivity.

catalog.title: Set bond thickness
catalog.description: Set the radius of the bond cylinders. Their diameter is twice this value. Display thickness does not change which atoms are connected.

catalog.title: Color both halves from their atoms
catalog.description: With atoms, the first half takes one endpoint atom’s color and the second half takes the other. The halves meet at the midpoint.

catalog.title: Fill a polygon or zeolite tile
catalog.values: Path to a polygon-face JSON file
catalog.description: Load an ordered polygon boundary from explicit vertices or zero-based atom indices. A single face is sufficient; a complete cage is optional. Alpha in the face color controls translucency.
catalog.note: For visible oxygen atoms, include the bridging O positions in the polygon loop. CIF input requires conversion first.

catalog.title: Show the unit-cell edges
catalog.description: Draw depth-tested cell edges. Hiding them also removes cell and vacuum extents from auto-framing.

catalog.title: Set unit-cell stroke thickness
catalog.values: Greater than 0, up to 32 output pixels; default 2
catalog.description: Change the width of the inner cell line independently of atom and bond outlines.

catalog.title: Use dashed unit-cell edges
catalog.description: Choose a continuous or dashed stroke for the cell boundary.

catalog.title: Choose the cell stroke color
catalog.description: Set the inner unit-cell line color and opacity. Use black with a white contour for contrast over colored atoms.

catalog.title: Add a white contour
catalog.description: Surround the inner cell stroke with white. It follows dash segments and their ends; zero disables it.

catalog.title: Adjust the dash pattern
catalog.description: Set the length of each dash and the blank space between dashes. These settings apply to dashed cell lines.

catalog.title: Label visible atoms
catalog.description: Display element symbols or zero-based rendered-instance indices. Collision filtering suppresses labels that would overlap or lie behind surfaces.

catalog.title: Show element colors and counts
catalog.description: Add a legend that counts all displayed atom instances, including repeated and hidden atoms.

catalog.title: Add Cartesian axes
catalog.description: Project the Cartesian X, Y and Z directions into the image. These are world axes, rather than lattice a, b and c.

catalog.title: Show physical scale
catalog.description: Add a fitted bar labeled in angstroms, based on the final camera scale.

catalog.title: Write a PNG, JPEG or WebP image
catalog.values: Local destination path; no default image path
catalog.description: The filename extension selects the image format. PNG is always supported; JPEG and lossless WebP require optional build capabilities.
catalog.note: JPEG needs opaque pixels. Images cannot be written to stdout.

catalog.title: Choose the PNG encoder
catalog.values: libdeflate when available, otherwise libpng; optional cairo
catalog.description: Select an encoder supported by your build. Libdeflate and libpng preserve image pixels; the experimental Cairo encoder has transparent-RGB limitations.

catalog.title: Balance PNG size and write time
catalog.description: Choose lossless compression effort. Auto selects an encoding level for the destination filesystem. Start at 1 for compact output with modest encoding effort.

catalog.title: Choose the PNG row filter
catalog.values: none, sub, up, adaptive; default depends on encoder
catalog.description: Control the scanline filter before compression. It changes encoding effort and size, while libpng/libdeflate preserve the decoded pixels.

catalog.title: Reuse a JSON recipe
catalog.values: One JSON path, or - for stdin
catalog.description: Load rendering settings, then override selected fields with explicit command-line flags. Objects merge by field and arrays replace.

catalog.title: Start from reproducible built-in defaults
catalog.description: Skip automatically discovered personal preferences for this invocation. Explicit recipes and command-line options still apply.

catalog.title: Create personal preferences
catalog.values: Run alone; refuses to overwrite an existing file
catalog.description: Create a starter config in your user configuration directory. Edit it to set the defaults you use most often.
catalog.note: Uses an absolute XDG_CONFIG_HOME, otherwise HOME/.config. Never copy a complete machine-specific invocation into this preferences file.

catalog.title: See settings and where they came from
catalog.description: Print resolved configuration, runtime settings and per-field provenance. Useful when a personal default, recipe and CLI flag interact.

catalog.title: Check a recipe before rendering
catalog.values: Input path optional unless the settings need input identity
catalog.description: Validate combined settings, selectors and build requirements without writing an image. Include an input to check atom indices and element identities.

catalog.title: Get machine-readable JSON rules
catalog.values: config (default), user, job, worker, faces; run alone
catalog.description: Print a Draft 2020-12 schema for settings, preferences, invocations, batch requests or polygon-face files.

catalog.title: Bundle input, output and settings
catalog.values: JSON path, or - for stdin; exclusive with --config
catalog.description: Load a complete invocation containing paths and embedded rendering settings. Paths in a job file resolve relative to that file.

catalog.title: Save a reproducibility record
catalog.description: Write a successful render’s settings, counts, input/output hashes and stage timings. It complements the image with a compact record.

catalog.title: Return structured error details
catalog.description: Format failures as JSON on stderr with an error code, exit status, message and setting path where available.

catalog.title: Use a filename beginning with a dash
catalog.values: Put rendering options before the terminator
catalog.description: End option parsing so the next positional token can be a literal input path beginning with a dash.
catalog.note: Replace -structure.vasp with your filename; the other examples use files from the example kit.

catalog.title: Choose CPU parallelism
catalog.description: Choose render threads. Auto uses one for small images and up to eight for images at least 512 × 512, subject to environment limits.
catalog.note: Multiple threads require OpenMP. Divide CPUs between processes when launching several workers.

catalog.title: Measure the rendering steps
catalog.description: Write configuration, parse, scene, rendering and encoding timings to stderr. Repeat a comparable job to distinguish sustained behavior from one-off variation.

catalog.title: Render several requests in one process
catalog.values: First argument; read JSONL from stdin
catalog.description: Process render, validate, stats and clear_cache requests sequentially. Retain input and scenes within the cache budget; each render can use CPU threads.
catalog.note: Start in the directory containing the supplied inputs. Batch workers skip implicit personal preferences.

catalog.title: Bound retained batch data
catalog.description: Set the input/scene cache budget. Zero disables retention. This is a cache limit rather than a cap on all process memory.

catalog.title: Stop a batch after a chosen count
catalog.values: 1–1000000; default reads until end of input; batch only
catalog.description: Exit after this many nonblank requests. Useful when supervising or periodically replacing a worker.

catalog.title: Make a camera orbit or reaction movie
catalog.values: orbit, trajectory; no movie by default
catalog.description: Stream rendered frames directly into an MP4. Orbit moves the camera around one structure; trajectory plays all snapshots with fixed framing.
catalog.note: Requires ENABLE_FFMPEG=ON. Use even image dimensions and an opaque background. See the movie guide for input and codec requirements.

catalog.title: Set movie playback speed
catalog.description: Choose how many encoded frames play per second. This sets visual playback speed without assuming a physical simulation time step.
catalog.note: Requires a build with FFmpeg support.

catalog.title: Choose the length of an orbit
catalog.description: Set the number of camera poses. At 24 fps, 120 frames play for five seconds. Full turns avoid duplicating the first pose at the end.
catalog.note: Requires a build with FFmpeg support.

catalog.title: Choose the world axis of rotation
catalog.description: Orbit around a world Cartesian axis through the displayed structure center. View, up and right rotate together without a pole flip.
catalog.note: Requires a build with FFmpeg support.

catalog.title: Set the orbit angle and direction
catalog.values: Nonzero −3600 to 3600 degrees; default 360; orbit only
catalog.description: Choose a full revolution or a partial arc. Negative angles reverse direction. Partial arcs include both endpoint views.
catalog.note: Requires a build with FFmpeg support.

catalog.title: Smooth a supplied reaction path
catalog.values: 0–1000 inserted geometries per interval; default 0; trajectory only
catalog.description: Insert linearly interpolated Cartesian positions and cell vectors between source snapshots. The fixed camera fits every displayed pose.
catalog.note: Requires FFmpeg support. This smooths a supplied path; it does not calculate a reaction, infer atom mapping or unwrap periodic positions.

catalog.title: Select the MP4 encoder
catalog.description: Auto prefers FFmpeg’s libx264 H.264 encoder and otherwise uses native MPEG-4 Part 2. An explicit encoder must be available in the linked libraries.
catalog.example: qasr examples/cage.xyz --no-user-config --movie orbit --movie-codec mpeg4 --movie-frames 60 --cell off -o orbit.mp4
catalog.note: Requires FFmpeg support. YUV 4:2:0 MP4 output uses no alpha channel and is not lossless RGB.
